title: Fix the checkout payment report
prompt: This report should show, for each checkout step, how the customer paid and how many lines the basket had, but its two payment columns come out wrong. Fix `solve(checkout_events)`.
rules: `payment_method` and `payment_provider` are text, read from `payment.method` and `payment.provider`. A step with no payment yet has both missing.
`basket_lines` is the number of entries in `items`.
hints: Run the starter and compare its `payment_method` and `payment_provider` with the expected result. `printSchema()` on the result shows their types.
`F.col("payment")` is the whole struct, not one of its fields.
Each payment column needs its own dot path into `payment`.
explanation: The starter has two bugs. `F.col("payment")` selects the whole struct, so `payment_method` comes out as a struct instead of text; it needs `F.col("payment.method")`. `payment_provider` was copied from the line above and still reads `payment.method`; it needs `F.col("payment.provider")`. `F.col("payment").getField("provider")` works too. A `begin` step has no `payment` yet, and both dot paths return a missing value for it without any extra code. The rest of the starter was right: `F.size("items")` counts the basket lines.
